reason: The pitch is straight, and I like that he says he will tell me to fix a process instead of selling me something new. But I do not know him, and my customers are my whole business.
objection: A robot saying the wrong thing to a customer on the phone would cost me more than whatever time I am losing now.
would_change_my_mind: A name, a local number, and a guy who will come stand in my shop and show me exactly what he would change before I pay a dime.
